decisions.title: Sign or reject the endless hazard product contract
decisions.ask: Sign or reject the endless hazard contract (obstacles, enemies and items in phases)?
decisions.recommendation: Read the draft and sign it if you still want difficulty to come from hazards: it is the only lever past level 268 that keeps zoom and board size frozen.
decisions.context: The draft contract for obstacles, enemies and items is unsigned; five cards are covered by it.

decisions.title: Decide what happens past level 198 so levels keep getting harder
decisions.ask: After level 268, is the lever for endless difficulty hazards (the same decision as signing MAZER-HAZ-002) or a bigger board?
decisions.recommendation: Hazards: you ruled out zoom and board size, and without a new lever the ladder plateaus at 268.
decisions.context: The ladder ends at level 268; the lever after that is a product call.

decisions.title: UI rework migration: wave status report landed, umbrella to split pending the owner
decisions.ask: Is the UI rework still one umbrella, or split into child cards (MenuScene decomposition, Wave 6 proof surfaces, future-phaser retirement) with this card closed?
decisions.recommendation: Auditor recommendation: split into children and keep the umbrella as planning only until the acceptance matrix is evaluated.
decisions.context: The wave status report landed (PR #482): contracts layer done, migration layer not started, the menu scene is about 16,600 lines.

decisions.title: Decide the six design-board picks: font, quit confirm, start style, icons, backdrop, HUD
decisions.ask: Do you want the build agent to record the six design picks on its own judgement, or do you want to choose them yourself?
decisions.recommendation: Say "go" so the build agent records each pick with its reason (quit confirm is already shipped as MAZER-FLOW-005); that unblocks MAZER-UI-010, UI-015, VIS-011 and VIS-012.
decisions.context: Six design picks are unrecorded (display font, quit confirm, START style, icon construction, backdrop, play HUD) and four graphics cards wait on them.

decisions.title: Collect the Galaxy S21 sign-in details from the owner family member
decisions.ask: Please ask her: (1) Did she open Mazer from the home-screen icon, and was it Chrome she installed it from? (2) Where did she see the words about a session: the Create Account form or inside the game, and as close to word for word as possible? (3) Did a browser or address bar appear on top of the app? (4) Did she use a username or the account address, and try several times in a row (the username limit is 15 minutes)? (5) Roughly what time did she try, before or after the sign-in fixes at about midday on 2026-11-11?
decisions.recommendation: Relay her answers on this card; do not guess a cause before then.
decisions.context: The Galaxy S21 sign-in failure has no confirmed cause; the answers decide which candidate is real.

decisions.title: Tell sign-up users their username shows on the leaderboard: live, phone check open
decisions.ask: Confirm the sign-up line copy (This username shows on the Mazer leaderboard.) and look at it once on your phone.
decisions.recommendation: Keep the copy.
decisions.context: PR #124 is merged and live (headless readback of the sign-up screen); the owner has not confirmed the copy and nothing is checked on a phone.

verify.step: Open the account-site Create Account screen on your phone.
verify.expected: The line This username shows on the Mazer leaderboard. is visible before you submit; a duplicate sign-up notice appears as its own line, not in the button label.

decisions.title: Account-site sign-out no longer races to login: merged, not live until aliases move
decisions.ask: Should signing out on the account site also end the Mazer session?
decisions.recommendation: Fix the race first; decide the session question as a separate step.
decisions.context: The race fix needs no decision, but whether account-site sign-out should also end the Mazer session is a design choice.

decisions.title: Username sign-in lockout (v4) live and sign-in verified; v5 proposal open, not applied
decisions.ask: Review the v5 proposal (FawxzzyWeb PR #133) and decide whether its exact SQL may be applied.
decisions.recommendation: Review the differences from live v4 first; nothing is applied until you approve the exact SQL.
decisions.context: v4 is live and a coordinator sign-in check passed. FawxzzyWeb PR #133 (v5) is an open proposal: failures-only check and record, keyed by username and client, no forwarded-address header; its SQL is not applied.

decisions.title: AI runner calibration: per-band thresholds and checker landed, retention not built
decisions.ask: Drop remote run retention, or approve it as a separate provider-side step?
decisions.recommendation: Drop it: the seed-pack runner is enough.
decisions.context: Thresholds and checker landed (PR #479) with no baseline drift; remote run retention is not built.

decisions.title: Decide whether the game has sound
decisions.ask: Should Mazer have sound at all, and should it default to on or off?
decisions.recommendation: Allow small synthesized effects behind a Settings toggle, default off.
decisions.context: There is no audio anywhere in the game and no sound setting.

decisions.title: Offline-first contract: proof fixtures landed, owner signing and device test open
decisions.ask: Sign or amend the offline sync contract, and run the airplane-mode check on a phone.
decisions.recommendation: Sign the contract as written for the client part; keep server parts blocked until approved.
decisions.context: Proof fixtures landed (PR #476); the owner contract signing, a device airplane-mode test and the provider-gated server parts are open.

verify.step: Play a level with airplane mode on, then turn the network back on and wait.
verify.expected: Progress is kept and flushes once the network returns, with no duplicate or lost completion.

decisions.title: Sign the shop and random item economy contract
decisions.ask: Sign or reject the shop and random-item economy draft contract?
decisions.recommendation: Defer signing until the hazard contract is settled; no Phase 1 work depends on it.
decisions.context: The draft contract for coins, shop and random items is unsigned; most not-started economy cards depend on it.

decisions.title: Decide: resume the same maze after quit or reload
decisions.ask: When a player quits or reloads mid-level, should the same maze resume or should the next Start roll a new maze?
decisions.recommendation: Resume the same maze so quitting is not a free re-roll (needs seed plumbing).
decisions.context: Quitting or reloading today discards the attempt, so the next Start is a free re-roll.

decisions.title: Decide when input unlocks during the level intro
decisions.ask: When should input unlock after reaching the goal: as now (about 2.5 s), at 75 percent of the reveal, or when the beams land plus a margin?
decisions.recommendation: Keep the current unlock: you twice said build and deconstruct felt too fast.
decisions.context: After a goal input is locked about 2.5 s; an earlier unlock touches the timer, pacing and AI scoring.

decisions.title: Turn-synchronous simulation: phase status table landed, only the player phase is live
decisions.ask: Will hazards and enemies be activated, and must they run through the turn host?
decisions.recommendation: Auditor recommendation: defer all non-player phases explicitly until hazards have a shipped product contract, then mark the card completed with a caveat once a deferral table lands.
decisions.context: The Phase Status table landed (PR #472): only the player movement phase is live and six other phases are deferred pending MAZER-HAZ-002; whether hazards and enemies are activated is the owner decision.

decisions.title: Add a Reduce Motion setting: merged and deployed, crossfade length still open
decisions.ask: Under Reduce Motion, keep the dock travelling band and the touch-stick anchor orbit held still, or let either one move?
decisions.recommendation: Keep both held still; colour still shifts, so the dock and stick stay lively without movement.
decisions.context: PR #425 is merged and live. Under reduced motion the dock travelling band and the touch-stick anchor orbit are held still, which is a judgement call; the shared crossfade length is carried by MAZER-MOTION-005.

decisions.title: Cheaper trail while walking: draft PR #461 needs an owner decision, no pixel parity
decisions.ask: After a phone check, choose: A ship as is; B cap cache epochs at 500 ms; C keep the smooth colour and accept the lag; D staggered per-chunk recolour or an OffscreenCanvas worker.
decisions.recommendation: Close draft PR #461: the owner reports no more lag; revisit only if lag returns (option D stays the follow-up).
decisions.context: Draft PR #461 (head 476e5cf2, CI not started, not merged) cuts walking frame cost about 1.3 to 2 times but cannot keep pixel parity: trail colour, sheen and breath would step every 250 ms to 1 s on long routes.

decisions.title: Settle the install gate policy and prove the offline shell
decisions.ask: Should the install gate stay mandatory in install modes where it blocks boot, given access is meant to be enforced by entitlement?
decisions.recommendation: Keep the gate as shipped until entitlements exist (MAZER-ECON-003), then revisit.
decisions.context: The install gate blocks boot in some install modes without a skip, which clashes with enforcing access by entitlement.

verify.step: Install Mazer on the phone, open it once online, turn on airplane mode, force-close the app and open it again.
verify.expected: The app shell opens and shows the offline-capable start screen.

decisions.title: Cross-viewport reliability: viewport matrix and presets landed, rotate check pending
decisions.ask: With Board Zoom removed and the board size frozen, is any layout persistence still wanted, or should that criterion be dropped?
decisions.recommendation: Auditor recommendation: drop the persistence criterion; keep the viewport matrix and the device check.
decisions.context: The viewport matrix and presets landed (PR #480); the layout persistence criterion has no state to persist.

verify.step: On the iPhone installed app: open the menu, rotate portrait to landscape and back mid-play, and open Settings and Guide in each orientation.
verify.expected: Play pauses on the flip and refits, no clipped panels or purple bars, tap targets reachable, state intact after rotating back.

decisions.title: Unify the backdrop across boot, install gate and sign-in
decisions.ask: Approve one near-black canvas colour across boot, install gate and sign-in, with a calmer gate starfield, the app icon on the install screen and a dot-matrix wordmark on boot?
decisions.recommendation: Approve it; portal alignment is tracked as a separate card in another repo.
decisions.context: Three visual dialects exist (game, install and sign-in pages, account portal); this is the backdrop pick in MAZER-UI-020.

decisions.title: Complete the World Identity visual maintenance lane
decisions.ask: Close World Identity as a completed lane (new work ships as discrete render cards) or keep it as a standing maintenance bucket?
decisions.recommendation: Auditor recommendation: close with a caveat and open one card per concrete defect; an in-progress card with no finish line hides real state.
decisions.context: Open-ended maintenance lane with no finish line; its text predates Chip tiles, diamonds and the Nov 10 render fixes.

verify.step: On the iPhone installed app, open the menu and play on the current build; watch the backdrop stars, end markers and trail for 30 seconds.
verify.expected: No strobing recolour, no image or vector misalignment, the end star is centred and the trail does not shake (PR #416 fixes).

decisions.title: Resolve the duplicate-username collisions with the oldest account winning
decisions.ask: Flip the pair_extension_recorded flag in file 05 and approve its hash.
decisions.recommendation: Oldest account wins; the others keep email sign-in.
decisions.context: The resolution changes which account keeps a public username.

decisions.title: Taken username named on the account site: merged, not live; Fitness patch proposed as text
decisions.ask: Is it acceptable for the account site and Fitness to say a username is taken?
decisions.recommendation: Yes for sign-up, since the leaderboard already shows names; keep the generic error vague.
decisions.context: A plain taken-username message tells a visitor that the name exists.

decisions.title: Show a failure code a player can read off a phone
decisions.ask: Pick where a short failure code may be shown to a player.
decisions.recommendation: A small line under the failure message with the short code only.
decisions.context: Showing a code is a copy and privacy choice.

decisions.title: Optionally backfill the stored display name for already renamed profiles
decisions.ask: Run the optional display name backfill, or leave the old values?
decisions.recommendation: Do not run it.
decisions.context: Backfilling overwrites display names players may have chosen on purpose.

decisions.title: Add shared-seed daily and weekly challenges
decisions.ask: Do you want shared-seed daily and weekly challenges, and at what cadence?
decisions.recommendation: Park until the economy and hazard contracts are settled.
decisions.context: The server seed and leaderboard parts would need a provider change.

decisions.title: Decide off-scale loops and durations and sweep dead motion code
decisions.ask: Decide which off-scale loops and durations move onto the motion scale and which stay as they are.
decisions.recommendation: Decide value by value with before and after captures; anything you do not name stays unchanged. Then sweep the dead motion code.
decisions.context: Some loops and durations are off the motion scale and some motion code is dead; each move changes how something looks.

decisions.title: Cap the trail canvas backing resolution on 3x phones
decisions.ask: Review the trail pixels on your 3x phone once the cap is built and approve or reject it.
decisions.recommendation: Build it behind the cap and look at one level before deciding.
decisions.context: A lower backing resolution could soften the trail on 3x phones.

decisions.title: Decide a minimum tile size for very large boards
decisions.ask: Should the game set a minimum tile size for very large boards, or explicitly defer zoom?
decisions.recommendation: Defer explicitly and record it, since board size and zoom are frozen.
decisions.context: On a 390 phone at level 99 the tile is about 6.5 px, so the player and goal are tiny.

decisions.title: Provide approved app icon art with proper corners and a clean screenshot capture route
decisions.ask: Provide approved app icon art with proper corners (or say to keep the current icon).
decisions.recommendation: Supply a master without baked corners; the build agent then regenerates the icons, the hash verifier and clean screenshots.
decisions.context: The icon master has baked black corners and new icon art is owner-gated; screenshots carry a small preview label.

decisions.title: Define a handcrafted asset authoring and import workflow
decisions.ask: Do you want a handcrafted-asset import workflow, and in which file format?
decisions.recommendation: Park it as deferred; no open card depends on it.
decisions.context: Not started; needs an owner decision on the asset format.

decisions.title: Route auth, sync, username and boot errors into the message toast
decisions.ask: Which of auth, sync, username and boot errors should appear in the message toast?
decisions.recommendation: Keep remote sync silent, show boot errors on the splash, and toast only the service-worker warning that the offline cache could not update.
decisions.context: Remote sync is deliberately silent today, so showing sync failures changes that stance.

decisions.title: Decide dense-board player prominence after the tile-sized ring
decisions.ask: On dense boards, accept the thin player ring, or add a screen-pixel floor on the glow only?
decisions.recommendation: Accept: the ring now matches the end tiles and the find-me ping still finds the player. The alternative is a screen-pixel floor on the glow only.
decisions.context: The ring is now tile-sized: on 8 px tiles it is a thin ring that shows only from 2x displays, and the find-me ping finds the player.
